description: This file defines the BlockContentForm class, a form handler for editing and managing content blocks within Drupal's block content module. It includes methods for rendering the form, handling form submissions, and configuring block settings.

classes.name: BlockContentForm
classes.description: Form handler class for editing Drupal block content entities, extending ContentEntityForm to provide custom form logic for block content.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the form for editing or creating a block content entity, customizing the title and CSS classes.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, adding a 'Save and configure' button if certain conditions are met.

methods.name: configureBlock
methods.description: Handles redirection to block configuration page after saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the block content entity, logs the operation, and redirects or rebuilds the form based on success.
